JTP Analytics provides independent marketing measurement support for organisations that already have meaningful data and need better answers from it. Engagements can cover a complete modelling project, a focused analysis, an independent audit or ongoing support for an internal or agency team.

## Bespoke modelling

Models are designed around the decision they need to support, rather than forcing every organisation into the same template.
:::

::: {.service-detail-media}
<img src="images/mmm-stacked-decomposition.png" alt="A stacked Marketing Mix Modelling decomposition showing changing channel contributions over time" loading="lazy">
:::
:::

::: {.service-detail-body}
Typical projects include:

- Marketing Mix Modelling to estimate channel contribution, returns and uncertainty.
- Budget optimisation and scenario planning to explore where additional spend can work hardest.
- Hierarchical models for campaigns, products, regions or other related parts of a business.
- Product adoption and launch forecasting, including uncertainty around future demand.
- Bespoke Bayesian and time-series models for questions that do not fit an off-the-shelf solution.

Deliverables are agreed during scoping and can include the model, validation, documented assumptions, decision-ready outputs and a practical handover.
:::
:::

::: {.service-detail-section}
::: {.service-detail-lead}
::: {.service-detail-copy}
## Incrementality testing

Attribution records where conversions were credited. Incrementality asks how many outcomes were actually caused by the activity.
:::

::: {.service-detail-media}
<img src="images/incrementality-uplift.png" alt="An incrementality analysis showing an observed outcome separating from its counterfactual after an intervention" loading="lazy">
:::
:::

::: {.service-detail-body}
JTP can help with:

- Designing geo-experiments, holdouts and switch-on or switch-off tests.
- Assessing whether an experiment is feasible before budget or markets are committed.
- Analysing test results with appropriate causal methods and uncertainty.
- Connecting experimental evidence to MMM assumptions and calibration.
- Building an experimentation roadmap where not every channel can be tested at once.
:::
:::

::: {.service-detail-section .service-detail-section--media-left}
::: {.service-detail-lead}
::: {.service-detail-copy}
## Model audits and validation

An independent review can reveal whether a model is credible enough for the decisions being made from it.
:::

::: {.service-detail-media}
<img src="images/model-audit-inspection.png" alt="A statistical model being examined closely to reveal uncertainty, assumptions and an anomalous result" loading="lazy">
:::
:::

::: {.service-detail-body}
Audits can examine:

- Data suitability, transformations and feature construction.
- Model structure, assumptions, priors and constraints.
- Validation, holdout performance and sensitivity.
- Channel contribution, ROI and uncertainty estimates.
- Reproducibility, documentation and maintainability.
- Whether the outputs support the intended commercial decisions.

The result is a clear assessment of what is working, what needs attention and what should happen next. An audit can be used before accepting a vendor model, before a major planning cycle or when results do not pass a commercial sense check.
:::
:::

::: {.service-detail-section}
::: {.service-detail-lead}
::: {.service-detail-copy}

## Privacy-resilient measurement

The loss of third-party cookies and incomplete user-level tracking make platform attribution a less dependable foundation for long-term planning. MMM, controlled experiments and causal methods work primarily with aggregate outcomes and variation over time or geography. They can therefore provide useful evidence without relying on a complete trail of individual user journeys.

No method removes every limitation. JTP will make assumptions and uncertainty explicit, and recommend the simplest credible method for the decision at hand.

## Is JTP a good fit?

JTP is best suited to UK and US organisations with mature data, established marketing activity and stakeholders ready to act on the findings. Direct-to-consumer businesses are a particularly strong fit, although the methods apply across many sectors.

JTP works with no more than four clients concurrently so each engagement receives meaningful senior attention.
